decision: Kept list filters as the same query keys on the detail URL, and did not nest them in a from parameter
why: A nested value would have broken the existing check that a mine-queue link still contains queue=mine as plain text

decision: Previous and next walk the same filters as the list, while page stays on the link only
why: Otherwise Next would leave the filtered set and Back would return to it

decision: Hid review cycle 0 instead of relabeling the pill, and said on the dashboard how many applicants have not entered a cycle
why: Cycle 0 is the schema default for not started, so a pill would look like a real cycle

decision: Did not add detail pages for interest or waitlist
why: Those lists have no record workflow, so a detail page would be a dead end of its own

decision: Did not link nomination intake counts to the desk status filter
why: Invited, applied, and declined are intake words, not desk statuses

decision: Replaced underlined back links with an icon button, and previous and next with labeled buttons that disable at the ends
why: The request asked for buttons, and a disabled end should not be a link

decision: Added one admin Button with primary, solid, outline, ghost, and danger, and left the public site alone
why: The public site already had the gradient, black, and outline treatments to reuse

decision: Left the confirm dialog cancel as a native button using the outline class
why: The shared Button does not forward a ref, and the dialog focuses cancel on open

decision: Reset a dismissed toast during render when the message changes, instead of inside an effect
why: The lint rule rejects setState inside an effect, and a repeated message still shows again after it clears

decision: Skipped loading PostHog when the path is under /admin
why: The console should not start the analytics client. The existing drop of admin events stays

decision: Ran npm test, tsc, and eslint after the pass. 204 tests passed
why: The done check includes those three staying clean

decision: Shot before and after of the header, list, nomination, dashboard, and button strip from sample data, then deleted the preview route
why: There is no database in this environment, so the real admin routes cannot sign in

decision: Neighbor links keep the page you opened from, and the query does not treat page as a filter
why: Going next from the last row of a page should reach the next record, and Back should return to the page you started on

decision: The plain queue=mine check lives in the review test, not in the href helper
why: The earlier row pointed at the helper. The constraint it protects is the test

decision: Message neighbors, nomination createdAt, and the confirm redirect use the same return query
why: Those files changed so next and the post-confirm redirect stay inside the filtered list

decision: A dismissed notice is covered by a test that clears the message and sets the same text again
why: The toast row had no test for coming back

decision: Removed an unused language-name import on the public switch
why: Full eslint with no warnings was already failing on that import, and the switch still uses the locale list

decision: Timeline statuses use the same names as the pills, and a missing record stays inside the console with a way back to Records
why: The earlier pass left raw status codes on the timeline, and a bad id dropped the nav
